title: An Autonomous, Large Language Model Driven X-ray Microscope with Contextual Understanding of Domain Specific Experimental Workflows
content: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) models have swiftly made their mark in the scientific community, revolutionizing data collection, automation, scientific analysis, and literature searching [1]. Context-aware Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown the capability to synthesize multiple data input streams and user instructions [2], to execute complex scientific tasks [3]. This presentation will explore the application of these agents in designing and autonomously executing intricate experimental workflows.
